from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from sasviya.core import Datalib, Table
from sasviya.ml.linear_model import Lasso

file_path = Path("./data/").resolve() / "hmeq1.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
# You can get the global style using this environment variable
# %set_env GRAPHICS_THEME=htmlencore
%set_env AUTO_GRAPHICS=true

env: AUTO_GRAPHICS=true
In [2]:
inputs = ["CLAGE", "DEBTINC", "LOAN", "MORTDUE", "VALUE", "REASON", "JOB"]
target = ["BAD"]

# a table view with inputs only
x_train = df[inputs]

# a table view with target only
y_train = df[target]

# create a LogisticRegression object
r = Lasso()

# train the model
r.fit(x_train, y_train)
